claims.quote: The palespotted cory, Hoplisoma gossei, long known as Corydoras gossei, is an armoured catfish from the rio Mamoré watershed in Rondônia state, northwestern Brazil.
It is also likely to occur in northern Bolivia, since the Mamoré forms the border between the two countries at the type locality.
